sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the informant Sushma Devi has filed a case under Section 498A IPC against the petitioner but as a matter of fact, she is not his legally wedded wife.
On the order of the High Court, an enquiry was conducted and in that enquiry, it was held that she is not wife of the petitioner.

Issue notice to the opposite party No. 2, both under registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary process, for which requisites etc. must be filed within three weeks, failing which the application shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.
List the matter after four weeks.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.77703 of 2018(3) dt.19-01-2023 Till then, further proceeding of the learned trial court is stayed.

On the order of the High Court, an enquiry was conducted and in that enquiry, it was held that she is not wife of the petitioner.
